raw_evidence.doubt: The label CONTRADICTED is questionable: the same 4-star reviewer writes "I know Pattaya is able to deliver better results" and "Averaged from my last review, this is 4 stars", which hints at a prior (positive) review/experience and could be read as supporting the claim that a customer previously enjoyed their meals. The contradicting quotes only show the current meal was mediocre, not that prior meals were unenjoyable.

rejected_quotes.quote: While the merger is a nice change the old prices and spot is missed.

doubt: The fixed label is SUPPORTED, but no review clearly states the customer appreciated the new location. The closest quote (review 2) calls the merger "a nice change" yet explicitly says "the old prices and spot is missed," which leans against appreciation of the new location. Review 1 describes walking away due to mistreatment, and review 3 only notes the business appeared closed. The label appears questionable.
